title: Buy the Diagonal
setup: The two kings face each other in the center, Black's on c4, and its bishop on c6 is the piece holding everything together.
hint: One black piece is guarding the squares your queen wants. Price it, then check along the line it was covering.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxc6+}} removes the bishop with check. {{Rb8+}} drives the king to the edge and {{Qa4#}} closes the box. Taking a defender is a hunting move when the capture comes with check.
